Ahmedabad receives Commonwealth Games baton for 2030

Glasgow's Commonwealth Games 2026 closing ceremony marked the handover of the Games flag and baton to Ahmedabad, India, the host city for the 2030 Games. Indian boxers' performances at the 2026 Games exceeded expectations, contributing to India's medal tally. Singer Shankar Mahadevan is scheduled to perform at the closing ceremony. India concluded its 2026 campaign with 39 medals across various sports.
